rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 40 scanning sites combined for functional NM training; surface area NM also uses multi-site data (supp2)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Data from 40 sites were combined to create the initial full sample. These sites are described in detail in Supplementary file 1, including the sample size, age (mean and standard deviation), and sex distribution of each site. Many sites were pulled from publicly available datasets including ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, NKI-RS, OpenNeuro, PNC, and UKBiobank."
rci1_using_msad.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Appendix 1 / Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling

rci5_n.detail: model-1: Training partition N calculated from supp1 labeled training column (40 sites, sum of Train N per site); paper text states 'approx. N=22,000' for the full reference cohort including internal test set (train+test = ~14,473+~7,244 = ~21,717). model-2: Overall N calculated from supp2 (no train/test split reported in supp2); phase is effectively Overall for model-2.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Functional normative models were trained on a large multi-site dataset (approx. N=22,000) and evaluated in several test sets..." (main text). Site-level N provided in Supplementary file 1 (training column sum = 14,473 across 40 labeled sites) and Supplementary file 2 (total N = 43,146).
rci5_n.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model formulation; elife-85082-supp1-v2.xlsx.md; elife-85082-supp2-v2.xlsx.md

rci6_sex.detail: model-1: female_n and male_n calculated from supp1 training column (N_i × F%_i per site, summed across 40 labeled sites; total training N=14,473, female=7,517, male=6,956). model-2: calculated from supp2 (N_i × F%_i per site, summed; total N=43,146, female=21,767, male=21,379).
rci6_sex.supporting_text: Site-level Sex (F/M)% and N provided in Supplementary file 1 (functional model, training column) and Supplementary file 2 (surface area model, overall N).

rci7_age.detail: model-1: Weighted mean computed from supp1 training column: Σ(N_i × mean_i) / N = 579,877 / 14,473 = 40.07 years. Pooled SD computed combining within-site variance (N_i × SD_i²) and between-site variance (N_i × (mean_i − x_bar)²), divided by N: variance = 9,373,769 / 14,473 = 647.7, SD = 25.45 years. Age range not explicitly stated in paper. model-2: Weighted mean from supp2: Σ(N_i × mean_i) / N = 1,852,871 / 43,146 = 42.95 years. Pooled SD not computed. Age range not explicitly stated. Sites span from child/adolescent (~9–10 years, ABCD) to older adult cohorts (Cam-CAN, HCP-A, OASIS, UKB ~50–70 years).
rci7_age.supporting_text: Site-level age (mean, SD) provided in Supplementary file 1 (functional NM, training column) and Supplementary file 2 (surface area NM, overall). "The datasets used for training the functional models, the age range of the sample, and the procedures for evaluation closely resemble the structural normative models."
rci7_age.location: elife-85082-supp1-v2.xlsx.md; elife-85082-supp2-v2.xlsx.md; Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Results / Sharing of functional big data normative models
